paper_metadata.title: A review on wire arc additive manufacturing of Ni-based superalloys

evidence.quote: Other superalloys of interest from the Ni-based cluster are Inconel 825, hastelloy, nickel–copper (Ni–Cu), waspaloy, RENE-41, and nimonic.
